review_notes: The file has three generated TAlphaWff proof-term definitions, one TEnvFresh theorem and one TReflOn definition. It declares no simp lemmas, no @[simp] attributes and no rewrite rules. Its only simp use is the repeated `by simp only [fv_syn_c1c]`, `[fv_syn_c0]` and `[fv_syn_cnnc]` for free-variable side goals. These are explicit, targeted simp only calls. The same lemma names appear in other files, for example ReplaySupport/SetOperations3.lean and WellOrderPullback6.lean, which suggests they are deliberately non-global rules. I found no missing canonical simp lemma, no wrong-direction rewrite, no competing rules and no cycle that I could support from the sources. The file's real quality problem is the size and duplication of the generated terms. That falls under other rubrics, not this one. I did not open the definitions of the fv_syn_* lemmas, so I cannot say whether they carry @[simp] elsewhere. That would not change the result for this file.
